entities.name: Atarka clan
entities.description: A dragon clan of Tarkir whose goblins serve, and are often eaten by, their ravenous dragon masters.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir whose goblins are presented as the counterparts of the Atarka goblins.

events.summary: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping their dragon masters won't eat them.
events.quote: Atarka serving-goblins coat themselves with grease imbued with noxious herbs, hoping to discourage their ravenous masters from adding them to the meal.

relations.note: Atarka goblins are compared to their Temur counterparts
relations.quote: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.
